regime_context: Canada/TSX themes show broad but diffused participation; Big Banks lead in momentum and durability but are crowded, while Base Metals & Copper challenge with a wide margin. The absolute trend gate has historically helped control tail risk on this market. Macro backdrop is geopolitics-heavy with high unscheduled news flow.
emerging_watch: Base Metals & Copper closing the durability gap with Big Banks (durability >0.6) and rotation margin shrinking below 0.5 – a confirmed handoff pattern. Kill criterion: margin widens beyond 1.2 or Base Metals durability drops below 0.3.
